job.title: Scheduler/Rostering Officer
job.description:
• Work for a reputable NDIS organisation that gives back to our community
  • Darlinghurst location - close to public transport
  • One month temp assignment with view for extension
  • WFH flexiblity - 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
  • Very attractive hourly rate on offer
  • Supportive & friendly team environment where everyone works towards a common purpose
  • Commencing ASAP!
  • Working Holiday Visa applicants welcome to apply!

The Company

Our client, a highly regarded NDIS organisation based in Darlinghurst, is seeking an experienced and proactive Scheduler to join their team for an immediate temporary assignment. The organisation provides health care services to our community, with several sites located across Australia.
 
The Role
 
Reporting to the Head of Client Experience, you will be based in the Workforce Planning team and responsible for a variety of administrative duties, ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the department.
  • Liaise with clients to coordinate rostering and scheduling needs
  • Assist with workforce planning to ensure efficient resourcing and seamless service delivery
  • Provide general administrative support across the team
  • Maintain accurate records and databases and record management within Salesforce
  • Assist with ad hoc administration projects as required
 
This is a fantastic opportunity for a detail-oriented scheduler who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in providing exceptional support to our community
 
To be successful you will bring:
  • Previous experience in an coordination/scheduling/rostering or office support position
  • Exposure to the NDIS sector would be highly desirable
  • Strong ERP systems knowledge experience (Salesforce highly regarded)
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
  • A proactive, positive attitude and willingness to support the broader team
 
If you are available immediately and looking for your next temporary opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Accounts Receivable Officer
job.description:
Are you seeking a fulfilling accounts receivable role that positively impacts people's lives?
  • Work for a reputable values based community organisation that will make your days purposeful and rewarding
  • 3-month temporary contract, with opportunity to extend! 
  • Darlinghurst location - central and close to PT
  • Hybrid work opportunity - 3 days in the office, 3 from home
  • Monday to Friday - 9:00 - 5:00pm, full time role 
  • Attractive hourly rate on offer 
  • Collaborative culture - be taken on the journey and help thousands of Australians living with Disability
  • Strong company values such as integrity, respect, commitment, responsive and creative who look after their employees
  • Working Holiday Visas welcome to apply!
  
The Company

Our client is seeking a skilled and enthusiastic accounts receivable professional to join their finance team! You will be working for a leading community based organisation who provide choices for people with a disability, enabling them to regain and retain their independence within an inclusive community. Their head offices are based in Darlinghurst, with the opportunity to work from the comfort of your own home. 
  
The Role

Reporting to the Financial Controller, you will be responsible for end-to-end Accounts Receivable.

Maintaining a high level of organisation and attention to detail, your duties will include:
  • Manage customer accounts, invoicing, payments and reconciliations
  • Drive collections and aged debt recovery
  • Prepare invoices, credits and account statements
  • Review and correct Salesforce-related invoicing issues
  • Reissue corrected invoices and follow through to payment
  • Resolve billing queries, payment discrepancies and account issues
  • Conduct credit checks and manage customer credit limits
  • Support AR reconciliations, backlog management and wider Finance administration
  
What experience is required?
  • Proven experience in an Accounts Receivable role 
  • Experience using MYOB and/or Salesforce is preferred
  • Experience in an NDIS environment is desirable, but not essential
  • Strong reconciliation and financial administration skills
  • Confident communicator who builds strong relationships with stakeholders and suppliers
  • Highly organised and self-motivated, with the ability to prioritise and meet deadlines
  • Thrives in a busy environment, juggling multiple tasks with ease
  
Please apply now if you would like to join this wonderful organisation that is making a difference to our community. 

Good luck!

job.title: Senior HR Business Partner
job.description:
See out the end of the year and apply your HR skills to a role in a highly reputable nationally recognised organisation. 
  
  
Let's start with what's in it for you…
  • Work for a one of a kind, large Australian brand
  • Senior, hands-on role with a strong Employee Relations and Performance focus with some project work
  • Contract role until end of December with potential for the role to extend
  • Attractive hourly rate on offer
  • Full time - will consider applicants seeking 4 days or 9 day fortnight
  • 3/4 days in the office, 1 day from home
  • Docklands location - very close to public transport
  • Modern offices with onsite café
  • Work alongside a high performing, collaborative and experienced People & Culture team
  • ASAP start


The Company

With a values-led, ambitious and team-first culture, our client is currently looking for an experienced Senior People Business Partner to join their People & Culture team during a period of increased workload. The head office is based in Docklands and you will be joining a HR team that are dynamic and high performing. 


The Role

This is not your typical HRBP role supporting one dedicated client group.
You will work flexibly across the organisation, with a strong focus on Employee Relations and Performance matters, while also providing support across broader people initiatives and priority projects.

This is a great opportunity for someone who can hit the ground running, quickly build relationships across different areas of the organisation and provide trusted, practical HR advice in a busy environment.
  • Lead a varied portfolio of Employee Relations and Performance matters,
  • Provide confident, practical advice and support to leaders on complex people matters
  • Manage sensitive workplace matters with sound judgement
  • Lead and deliver priority People & Culture projects
  • Support organisational change activities
  • Assist with workforce, performance, engagement and other people processes as required
  • Maintain accurate case records, correspondence and supporting documentation
  • Work collaboratively with the wider People & Culture team to ensure matters are progressed and resolved efficiently
  • Identify recurring themes, risks and opportunities for improvement
  • Build effective working relationships quickly and adapt to different leaders, teams and operating environments
What will I need to succeed?
  • Proven experience in a Senior HR Business Partner/HR Manager/ER/IR specialist role within a fast paced and complex environment 
  • Strong knowledge of contemporary HR practices
  • A degree or Post Graduate Qualification in HR
  • Demonstrated knowledge with employee and industrial relations including Fair Work 
  • Ability to negotiate, influence and liaise to achieve desired outcomes
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work under pressure
  • Resourceful and have practical common sense
If you’re an experienced HRBP who is hands-on, loves ER and can jump in and make an immediate impact, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.
Interviews will be held immediately.
Good luck!

job.title: Executive Assistant to CFO & HR Director
job.city: Melbourne CBD & Inner Suburbs Melbourne VIC
job.description:
Are you eager to be part of an organisation that is truly making a difference to our community? 

  • Work for a reputable NFP organisation that gives back to our community
  • Varied EA role supporting a C-Suite Executive and a Director
  • VERY attractive salary on offer
  • Work from home flex - 4 days in the office, 1 days from home
  • 6 month temp assignment with the opportunity to go permanent
  • East Melbourne location - very close to public transport
  • Generous leave entitlements including additional long service leave, parental leave and study leave!
  • Other employee perks such as study assistance, EAP and mentorship
  • Inclusive, supportive environment, be part of a high performing HR team
  
The Company

An exciting permanent opportunity is available for an experienced Executive Assistant to support both an Executive and a Director within a highly respected not-for-profit organisation that truly makes a difference in our community. Based in East Melbourne, their modern and welcoming head office offers an enjoyable work environment, with the added flexibility to work from home 1 day per week.
  
The Role

The role is a varied and traditional one, where your main responsibility will be to provide a high level of executive administrative support to the CFO and HR Director.
Maintaining a high level of organisation and time management, your day to day responsibilities will include:
  • Diary and calendar management 
  • Email correspondence and draft communications on behalf of the Executives and Director
  • Coordinate travel and accommodation 
  • Organise internal and external meetings including catering and venues
  • Prepare agendas, action items and meeting minutes 
  • Organise lots of events and staff activities!
  • Prepare Power Point presentations and other documentation
  • Process invoices and credit card expenses
  • Other ad hoc administration tasks as required
  
What will you need to succeed?
  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-Suite Executives 
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills including Power Point
  • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal 
  • Ability to build, influence and develop strong trusting relationships
  • A professional and mature approach as well as immaculate presentation
  • Exercise judgement and discretion at all time

Please apply now to take the next step in your professional career!
Good luck!

job.title: Receptionist & Administration Assistant
job.description:
Are you an experienced Receptionist looking for a new opportunity where you can run your own ship?

Why don't we start with what's in it for you? 
  • Work for a leading infrastructure company that's booming!
  • Temporary role with the view to move into a fixed-term/perm position
  • Full-time Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week for the first 3.5 weeks, then moving to part-time, 3 days per week (you choose your days between Tuesday–Friday)
  • Hours: 7.30am - 4pm 
  • Port Melbourne location — close to public transport with free onsite parking
  • Varied role with additional administration responsibilities
  • Social culture with quarterly celebrations and regular staff events
  • Full-suite kitchen with fresh fruit, coffee machine and great amenities
  • Free onsite gym + classes available
  • Approachable management and a genuinely collaborative team
  • Plenty of training and support
  • Relaxed, casual working environment
  
The Company

Situated in Port Melbourne, we are seeking an experienced Receptionist and Administration Assistant to join an award winning infrastructure organisation. They company have a relaxed and casual working environment, with great onsite amenities such as a full-suite kitchen and gym. 

The office can be accessed via public transport and has free car parking available. The role will commence as a full time temporary opportunity for 3.5 weeks and then will move to a 3 day part time permanent position.

 
The Role 

As the first point of contact, this position will set the foundation for a positive client experience.

Your day to day duties will include but not limited to:
  • Meet and greet all visitors via phone and face to face, making them feel welcome
  • Answering and transfering calls in a professional manner
  • Maintain presentation and cleanliness across the office, kitchens and general areas
  • Coordinate boardroom bookings, mail and couriers 
  • Allocating invoices and raising purchase orders 
  • Document management, filing and achiving 
  • Provide administration support to the office 
  • Order stationery and supplies
  • Assist Directors with any requests 
  
What you will need to succeed?
  • Proven experience in a similar role in a reception/team/office administrator/customer/client service position
  • A genuine passion to learn and build a long and successful career
  • A willingness to be agile and adapt to any changes in the day to day  
  • Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
  • Enthusiastic and a "can-do" attitude
  • A warm, supportive communication style 
Apply now to enjoy being part of a successful and professional team.  
Good luck!

job.title: Events Operations Coordinator
job.city: Melbourne CBD & Inner Suburbs Melbourne VIC
job.description:
Are you an Events Coordinator/ Event Administrator eager to take your next step in an event based not-for-profit organisation? Look no further, we have the role for you!
  • Work in a values driven NFP organisation that aims to change the lives of young people
  • Work on large scale events, meaningful events with thousands of attendees
  • Work with an experienced mentor with a wealth of knowledge 
  • CBD location - accessible by public transport
  • Work from home flexibility - 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
  • Full time, permanent position 
  • Work in a high performing, 'all hands on deck' collaborative culture
  
The Company
Work for national not-for-profit which drives the success of young people. The organisation aims to showcase and promote excellence through programs, competitions, community projects and education pathways around Australia.
  
The Role
Working closely with the Head of Event Operations, you will be responsible for the coordination of the organisation's events, activities and programs. You will ensure that organisational activities are achieved in line with strategy, budget and time constraints. 

Your duties will include but not be limited to:
  • Coordinate local, state and interstate events and programs
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date event, volunteer and participant records within event management systems
  • Manage volunteer and participant engagement, communication and compliance requirements
  • Act as a primary point of contact for volunteers and key event stakeholders 
  • Support volunteer and participant logistics, including uniforms, travel, accommodation and on-site requirements
  • Liaise with venues, suppliers, contractors and key stakeholders to ensure successful program delivery
  • Obtain quotes and assist with financial administration to ensure accurate reporting of event related expenses
  • Provide on-site operational support during events, ensuring volunteers are fully briefed
  • Complete a high volume of administration, including database management and the ongoing maintenance of procedures, templates and operational documentation
What will you need to succeed?
  • Demonstrated experience in an Events Operations Coordinator/ Event Administrator position
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills
  • Strong project management, administrative and database management
  • Experience with event management or project management systems
  • Organisational skills, time management and ability to work to strict deadlines 
  • Budgeting, planning and project delivery skills 
  • Be a self starter who can work both autonomously and in a team environment
  • Ability to make considered decisions in a fast paced environment
Don't miss out on this excellent opportunity. Interviews will be held immediately.

Good luck!

job.title: Recruitment Specialist - 360 with no sales!
job.city: Melbourne CBD & Inner Suburbs Melbourne VIC
job.description:
LOVE working with people? Eager to build fulfilling partnerships with a vast array of organisations?
Then look no further…. 
  • Opportunity to work in an 360 Recruitment role without the pressures of sales and individual targets - team based role
  • Generalist and varied role - dual desk, work on array of positions across different industries!
  • Full time, permanent role
  • CBD location with WFH flexibility - 2 days per week after training 
  • Work in a fun, dynamic culture
  • Morning teas, lunches, fruit platters and company events & activities
  • Fast paced environment with lots of fun and laughs along the way
  • Attractive hourly rate on offer plus incentives
  • Boutique agency - plenty of learning opportunities, and one on one training and support
  
About Us
Hugo Personnel is an Australian owned and managed, corporate recruitment agency. We recruit across all industries in areas of customer service, administration, marketing, human resources and finance on a temporary, contract and permanent basis.

Our office is located right in the heart of the CBD, very close to public transport with work from home flexibility after the probation period.
  
The Role
Supporting our Recruitment Manager, you will work closely with a small team to manage a large portfolio of clients across permanent and temporary recruitment. 

Your main responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Collect recruitment briefs from the Recruitment Manager and clients
  • Resource a high quality of candidates across an array of permanent and temporary positions 
  • Submit and discuss shortlisted candidates with clients
  • Write job adverts, conduct phone, MS Teams and face to face interviews
  • Coordinate interviews, references and background checks
  • Visit the offices of new and existing clients with the Recruitment Manager
  • Negotiate and influence salary expectations and offers to candidates
  • Assist with filling short term temporary roles 
  • Optimise alternative recruitment strategies eg. Headhunt through Seek, LinkedIn and our referral program
  • Assist with the on-boarding process, ensuring a smooth transition
  • Administer the recruitment system (JobAdder)
  • Provide recruitment support to the wider recruitment team
  
What you need to succeed? 
  • Proven experience in recruitment/agency/internal/HR experience – but it’s really going to be your personality, energy and drive that sets you apart!
  • Qualifications in HR/Business/Marketing or a related field will be highly regarded, but definitely not essential
  • Experience managing end-to-end recruitment – desirable, but not essential
  • Ability to be agile, organised and juggle multiple priorities without dropping the ball
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills – you genuinely enjoy connecting with people
  • Someone who takes ownership, is accountable for their work and is honest and upfront – even when things don’t go to plan
Come join our close knit and energetic team who work hard but also have a lot of fun and laughs along the way.

Interviews will be held immediately! Good luck!

job.title: Sales Advisor
job.description:
• Join a reputable education provider making a genuine impact on student learning
  • Fantastic Sydney CBD location, close to public transport
  • 1-month temporary role with a strong opportunity to extend
  • Attractive hourly rate on offer
  • Monday to Friday, 8.30am–5pm
  • Fun, energetic and dynamic team culture
  • WHV applicants are welcome to apply


The Company

Our client is a well-established and award-winning education organisation that works with schools across Australia and internationally to help students develop stronger study skills, confidence and academic performance.
With a growing team based in Sydney CBD, this is an exciting opportunity to join a purpose-driven organisation that genuinely makes a difference to students and schools.
  
The Role

This is a phone-based sales role where you will be responsible for contacting existing clients, warm leads and cold leads, generating new opportunities and booking appointments.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Making outbound calls to existing clients and prospective clients
  • Following up on warm and cold leads
  • Building rapport and identifying opportunities
  • Generating leads and booking appointments
  • Managing follow-ups and maintaining accurate records
  • Working towards call and sales targets
  
What You Need to Succeed
  • Proven experience in an outbound call centre, sales, appointment setting or telemarketing role
  • Experience working in the education sector would be highly regarded, but is not essential – it’s all about personality!
  • A strong sales mindset
  • Great interpersonal skills and confidence speaking with people at all levels
  • Self-motivated with a positive and energetic vibe
  • Resilient, proactive and comfortable picking up the phone
If you’re someone who loves a good conversation and gets a buzz from winning business, we’d love to hear from you!
